next.reason: 1985 PADDING CHARACTER clause GR4: 'If the CODE-SET clause is specified for the file, conversion of the padding character specified by literal-1 or the content of data-name-1 is established for the file when the file is opened.' 2023 has no PADDING CHARACTER clause (absent from the file control formats of §2023:12.4.5.1 (General formats)), so there is no padding character to convert; the CODE-SET rules of §2023:13.18.13 convert record data only, and §2023:9.1.1 'Padding characters are added or deleted as necessary' does not name a user padding character. No 2023 rule carries this rule.
